stated: The Conservative Party will transform 16-19 education by introducing the Advanced British Standard, building on A Levels and T Levels to provide a broader education with more time in the classroom and requiring English and maths study up to 18.

source.quote: Transform 16-19 education by introducing the Advanced British Standard, enabling young people to receive a broader education and removing the artificial divide between academic and technical learning. ...Every young person will spend more time in the classroom, learning more subjects, including English and maths to 18...

bearing_set.reason: Directly restructures 16-19 education and skills provision, affecting school standards, breadth of attainment, and post-16 opportunity for all young people.

More classroom time and a rebuilt qualification structure require a substantial increase in teaching capacity and teacher supply; the IFS and others have flagged the multi-billion-pound cost of implementation, making this a concrete, non-negligible fiscal commitment.

membership_note: The clear cross-outcome tradeoff is a genuine education improvement (O7) traded against a significant fiscal burden (O12). Effects on O13 (productivity) and O4 (wages) are real but flow indirectly through O7 over a very long horizon — insufficient to earn a separate non-negligible verdict at this stage.
